poloidal_margin.reference: NI/(2 pi r t) at the inner leg (r = 0.6 m, t = 0.01 m)

psi.note: Psi recomputed with the critical-state static field and the same pickup mode, at the step with the largest drive scale; the baseline is the ideal (Meissner) model at drive scale 1, so relative_change divides by the peak scale. Psi(t) of every step is in `steps`

final.note: W_reduced_J is the energy of the field of the screening currents and windings; a background magnet's own energy is excluded, as in the static results

trapped.note: the drive is back at zero: the remaining field and moment are trapped flux

newton.note: convergence is measured on the Newton update; the residual ratio is reported for reference and is pessimistic (the power-law Jacobian spans many orders of magnitude)

Round the corner (fillet) for a meaningful peak field.
critical-state analysis: 'conductor' (normal metal) regions carry no eddy currents in the time-dependent solve, so the reported dissipation is the HTS loss alone
